name.zh: 蝎尾狮号：尼奥克斯边境

author: fireStartZero

description.en: A fan tribute to Galaxy on Fire 3: Manticore, told with GoF2's art. Join Bryce Vantok's mercenary carrier in the lawless Neox frontier and hunt the Gr'Gath clan to its warlord Sh'Gaal. Act I in five chapters: hangar 18 and Vh'Arus Tengs, the Ancile convoy and Reid Sladek, Ulrus in the Haze, D'Rak's raid on the Manticore, and the assault on the Maw. Act II in four chapters: the pirates' money leads through the jumpgate to Valtor, an accountant's escape, Nova's black ledger, outlawed, and the showdown with Director Crane at Paragon Spire. Story paraphrased, not GoF3's own text.
description.zh: 一份《银河火焰3：蝎尾狮号》的同人致敬，用 GoF2 的美术重新讲述。加入布莱斯·万托克的雇佣兵航母，在无法无天的尼奥克斯边境一路追猎格尔加斯氏族，直到军阀希加尔。第一幕共五章：18号机库与滕格斯、安喀勒船队与斯拉德克、薄雾中的乌鲁斯、德拉克突袭蝎尾狮号、强攻巨口要塞。第二幕共四章：海盗的资金穿过跃迁门通往瓦尔托，会计出逃、新星的黑色账本、被宣布为通缉犯，以及在典范尖塔与克莱恩总监的对决。剧情为转述改写，非 GoF3 原文。

credits: Story after Galaxy on Fire 3: Manticore (Fishlabs / Deep Silver), retold in our own words. Uses only the assets of the Galaxy on Fire 2 remake.
